histories.purpose: Recover actual annual-report representations; preserve directly restated dependent values as competent-baseline controls. Admission is not presumed.
Recover explicitly versioned abstracts and complete papers separately; verify same observations and exact revised assertions, retaining any direct conclusion correction.
Recover complete present article and notice as a possible full-document consistency case. These URLs do not provide an observed pre-correction article and cannot fill the historical gate.

source_budget.existing_bound_note: Keep the prior bounded transport envelope; an over-limit source is recorded as an access limitation. Any change needs a separately recorded pre-execution engineering amendment, not a hidden retry.
source_budget.allowed_transport: Available authorized primary-source retrieval only; no sign-in, challenge bypass, fabricated alternate URL or hidden retry.
source_budget.stopping_rule: Stop after these eight listed representations or earlier when remaining attempts cannot add a qualifying representation. Log every outcome and all unusable or incomplete material.
source_budget.source_completeness: Bind exact retrieved representation, full extraction and version metadata. A truncated web result, selected passage pack or abstract is not the full paper. Abstracts remain separate complete bounded source documents.
source_budget.historical_rule: No update removal, swapping restored numbers, reconstructed old prose or retrieval-date substitution to simulate a historical original. Version identity does not establish first public availability.

feasibility_target.scope: Retain existing source, dependency, control and authority admission requirements. A smaller access pilot neither replaces nor satisfies the eight-history target.

transport.question: Did the bounded attempt retrieve bytes, and what were the exact response and failure conditions?

full_representation.question: Is the intended representation complete, and is the claim-bearing content faithfully inspectable?

identity.question: Do captured contents and primary metadata establish the document, version, authors/issuer and relationship?

historical_version.question: Are actual earlier and corrective representations with the original and replacement assertions observed and ordered?

source_authority.question: Is the correction attributable to the same asserting authority under the unchanged core?
source_authority.authority_extension: Separate source-only reviewed amendment and preserved old-core comparison required.

correction_scope.question: Is there an explicit whole-assertion replacement within the same semantic scope?

explicit_dependents.question: Does the correcting source directly replace the proposed dependent assertion?

essential_dependency.question: Does a distinct source-present dependent require the corrected assertion, as grounded in text or a source-specified computation?

independent_retention.question: What unaffected assertion and alternative support routes remain independently supported?

axis_evaluation_schema.unknown_policy: An unknown is neither a pass nor a semantic rejection; explain the missing evidence. not_applicable requires justification.

candidate_incremental_propagation_case_a: No explicit correction of the selected dependent after inspection of the complete available correcting source.
No certified surviving alternative support that invalidates proposed withdrawal; unresolved alternatives block positive classification.
Dependence uses current whole-assertion same-authority AND-only semantics; no recomputation or inferred replacement value.
admission_requirements.control_admission: A complete certified history whose dependent is directly corrected may be a control, but supplies no residual propagation benefit. No hidden direct edge can be removed.
admission_requirements.historical_availability: Repository version/publication metadata can establish the documented order; first public availability remains separately unknown unless independently certified. Do not claim a historical availability evaluation without that evidence.
admission_requirements.natural_end_to_end_benchmark: This pilot alone does not admit a benchmark or validate retrieval, extraction, question routing or answer generation.
controlled_version_stream_core_case: Complete intended earlier and corrective representations and faithful claim-bearing extraction.
Document and version relationship established; actual old and replacement assertions observed.
Same asserting authority supported under unchanged rule.
Explicit same-scope independently meaningful whole-assertion replacement.
Distinct source-present downstream assertion and certified essential text/computation relationship.
Independently grounded unaffected retention control; alternative support explicitly assessed.
All directly corrected dependents retained; core assumptions compatible.
Separate source-only adjudication with locators, unknowns and review provenance frozen before predictions.
admission_requirements.controlled_stream_with_unknown_availabil: Complete actual versions with documented order and all unchanged semantic criteria may be admitted for controlled document-version development or direct-correction controls while first-public-availability remains unknown. Do not report them as historically clock-certified replay or fill unknown times.
admission_requirements.historically_clock_certified_replay: Requires independent evidence for the availability clock in addition to controlled-stream admission criteria; preserve separate certification status.

plug_power_2018_restatement.earlier_document_limitation: FY2019 report contains FY2018 comparatives; no first-original-publication claim.
plug_power_2018_restatement.direct_dependent_correction: Prior discovery observes EPS explicitly replaced; preserve if confirmed.
plug_power_2018_restatement.numeric_rule: Do not recompute EPS or certify exact arithmetic from rounded displayed values.

opera_1109_4897.scope_warning: Prior discovery reports instrumental corrections AND changed event selection; same-scope replacement must be independently adjudicated, not assumed from version identity.
opera_1109_4897.direct_dependent_correction: Preserve explicit velocity and conclusion replacements.
opera_1109_4897.abstract_limitation: Each abstract is distinct bounded source; neither substitutes for its corresponding full PDF.
opera_1109_4897.retention_control: Geodetic baseline is proposed only until its independence is verified.

scope_cautions: Preserve mortality versus prescribing outcome distinction.
Preserve exposure standardization and source methodological terminology.
Point-estimate ordering is not significance or causal ordering.
Current core does not recompute rankings.

review_sequence: Freeze exact capture receipts and extracted representations.
Separate source-only reviewer inspects axes and proposes admission and role before questions or predictions.
Record model assistance, prior familiarity, common inputs and reviewer identity; do not claim human gold or blind review.
Freeze adjudications, all direct and essential edges, controls, exclusions and uncertainties.
If a later comparison is justified, freeze answer/evidence references and matched input protocol before outputs.

stop_and_pivot_rules.attempt_stop: Stop after these eight listed representations or earlier when remaining attempts cannot add a qualifying representation. Log every outcome and all unusable or incomplete material.
stop_and_pivot_rules.unattempted_urls: Retain each fixed URL and explicit reason if early stopping leaves it unattempted.
stop_and_pivot_rules.no_quota: Do not add histories, relax semantic criteria or reinterpret unavailable content to meet target.
stop_and_pivot_rules.failed_historical_access: Keep longitudinal method gate closed; missing transport does not establish semantic failure or rarity.
stop_and_pivot_rules.no_nondirect_residual: Keep accessible directly corrected histories as controls; stop expanding current longitudinal method claim.
stop_and_pivot_rules.separate_consistency_pivot: Requires complete present documents, independently reviewed scope/references and a new frozen design; cannot silently become historical evaluation.
stop_and_pivot_rules.engineering_amendments: Preserve all previous attempts and freeze a separate amendment before any changed transport execution. No hidden retry; eligibility rules are not changed to force admission.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Complete historical sources cannot be recovered in the bounded pilot
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Keep longitudinal method gate closed; propose an explicitly separate full-document inconsistency study only after complete present documents and independent references are available.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Missing transport is not semantic failure or evidence of rarity.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Historical sources recovered, but every dependent assertion is already directly corrected
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Use these as direct-correction controls; do not claim incremental propagation value.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Do not hide explicit downstream corrections.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Matched reader, direct policy and dependency policy all answer correctly
later_comparison_decisions.decision: No answer-level advantage established; any efficiency claim needs its own matched measurements.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Support bookkeeping is not QA gain.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Reader fails but direct correction answers correctly, with no dependency improvement
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Investigate extraction and direct revision handling; no propagation claim.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Do not attribute direct-update benefit to graph propagation.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Dependency policy improves answers over reader and direct policy on certified nondirect dependencies
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Candidate method signal only; expand to independently held-out histories, ablations and uncertainty analysis before generalization.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: A development-case success is not algorithmic novelty or publishability proof.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Dependency policy withdraws a conclusion whose independent support remains valid
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Record over-withdrawal; preserve the independent branch and evaluate explicit support alternatives before broadening the method.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Loss of one premise does not establish falsehood.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: All methods fail or disagree because scope, retrieval, extraction or authority is unresolved
later_comparison_decisions.decision: Resolve or report that upstream issue separately; do not score fabricated annotations as natural end-to-end performance.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Identical model names do not create matched inputs.

later_comparison_decisions.condition: Exact solver improves only objective value or annotated support survival
later_comparison_decisions.decision: No answer-level or search-novelty claim; compare against restarted iterative baselines if a real residual problem remains.
later_comparison_decisions.forbidden_inference: Objective improvement does not entail useful answers.

excluded_claims: historical authenticity or availability from hashes
method performance from support-adapter unit tests
